label: Meal Planning Team
blurb: A Meal Planning Lead and 4 specialists who create practical menus, grocery lists, and preparation plans
purpose: Created for individuals, families, and organizers looking for dedicated support with meal planning. Create practical menus, grocery lists, and preparation plans. The team takes care of preparation, detailed planning, and practical follow-through to keep everything running smoothly.

project.name: Meal Planning
project.goal: Deliver a comprehensive initial meal planning plan with clear milestones, assigned responsibilities, and verified outputs.
